name: autoresearch
description: Read or append autoresearch run ledgers. {"op":"list"} (no run id) lists runs; {"op":"tail","run":"<id>","last":20} tails a run's ledger. {"op":"append","run":"<id>","summary":"...","ok":true,"metric":0.9,...} appends a ledger entry; this is the engine loop's per-iteration write, but a caller with the fields may use it too. Fields for append: summary, ok, metric, metric_name, iter, ts, duration_ms, detail, stdout, stderr.
llm_description: List runs (op list, no run id), tail a run's ledger (op tail, run + last), or append a ledger entry (op append, run + summary/ok/metric/iter...). Run ids are the ledger subdirectories under state/autoresearch/.

op.description: list (default): enumerate runs; tail: read a run's ledger; append: write a ledger entry

run.description: Run id (the state/autoresearch/<id> directory). Required for tail and append.

last.description: tail: how many trailing ledger lines to return. Defaults to 20.

summary.description: append: one-line summary of the iteration

metric.description: append: best-metric value for this iteration

metric_name.description: append: name of the metric being optimized

ts.description: append: unix seconds; omitted means now

duration_ms.description: append: wall time of the iteration

stdout.description: append: raw stdout, tailed to the ledger

stderr.description: append: raw stderr, tailed to the ledger
